findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - The release pull request runs its configured CI checks.
The proof list names `tests/test_guides_agree.py`, but `.github/workflows/forge.yml:88` runs `forge test --change`. The picker at `src/forge/fasttest.py:392` selects changed and related tests plus the entries in `.forge/always-tests.txt`; this diff does not select the guide suite, and it is not on that list. The separate plugin PR job runs other tests. The release can therefore pass its checks without running this named proof. Include the guide suite in the pull-request run.
Adds work: run the listed guide suite in PR CI; F 1 x H 2 = 2; 2 x C = 2
